'''Malsarr''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was present on [[Stroiketcy]],<ref name="GG2-2" /> a [[Gravity/Legends|gravitationally]] captured [[Comet/Legends|comet]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]<ref name="GG2-2" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Along with [[heglum]] and [[Iridium (element)/Legends|iridium]], malsarr was present at a high concentration in the form of suspension in Stroiketcy's partially [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]], which served as confirmation of both the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld's]] past as an object freely traveling through outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and the highly dynamic nature of its [[Water/Legends|seas]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]] is set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a radical interpretation of Stroiketcy's geographical features and tidal patterns had been proposed that posited the existence of small islands of dry land on the comet's surface at a point in its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Yavin/Legends|Yavin]]. Assuming the validity of that theory, a surveyor probe or a manned flight dispatched to Stroiketcy at that point held the potential of prospecting for malsarr ore deposits in the comet's bedrock.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malsarr was introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
